headline: Red Sox look to bounce back against Rangers in Texas tonight
morning_brew: That last result stung like a paper cut on a lemon. I was staring at the boxscore for way too long, basically trying to negotiate with the TV to change the outcome. Texas jumped on us early, and when you dig a hole that deep against a team fighting for their own playoff life, it takes a hell of an effort to climb out. We didn't have the magic in the bats, but there is no time to mope when the schedule is as relentless as a trip down the Pike at five on a Friday.

Patrick Sandoval had a rough go on the mound, and giving up those early runs put us behind the eight ball from the jump. It was a total disastah, but you have to give credit to the bullpen for stopping the bleeding. Jovani Morán and Brayan Bello were sharp in their relief appearances, showing the kind of composure we need to see from the arson squad if we are gonna make some noise when the leaves turn.

Tonight is a new opportunity to even the series and prove we can handle the pressure on the road. The Rangers aren't gonna roll over, and we need to be the aggressors from the first pitch to make sure we aren't playing catch-up all night. I am not sweating the standings just yet, but taking care of business in these head-to-head matchups is exactly what a team in our position has to do to keep the Duck Boat fund alive.
